title: Confirmed ReadProperty for device object identifier
purpose: Exercise a common confirmed service path with object/property parameter structure while preserving credible BACnet/IP framing.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP target should parse the frame as a confirmed ReadProperty request for a device object and either return the property value or an application-level error if the object instance is absent.
constraints_preserved: Confirmed-request PDU type uses first APDU octet 0x00
Confirmed service choice 0x0C for ReadProperty is directly source-backed
Service body uses conservative standard BACnet tagged fields for object identifier and property identifier because full per-field grammar is not supplied in the excerpts
issue_safety_notes: Valid confirmed-service seed; uses ordinary object/property access structure and avoids malformed lengths or response-only PDUs.
